accepted_conclusions: The official application bytes can be launched through a byte-identical alias on the hosted Windows runner.
The complete select-input, select-output, validate, native-terminal and native-report transaction is repeatable for this frozen empty-root case.
The three native reports are semantically identical after removing volatile execution metadata.
rejected_overclaims: The original Chinese-name wrapper has stock-environment parity on the hosted runner.
A valid China eCTD sequence has been produced.
Any individual PDF detector has been calibrated against the official validator.
The repeated empty-root result establishes acceptance compatibility.
known_ambiguities: The validator warns that the selected 0000 sequence folder is not numeric, despite the apparent four-digit name. The run continues after explicit confirmation and produces a native report, so this is not a precondition-only observation; the warning still requires an isolated 0001 experiment.
The field official_wrapper_ui_reached in the aggregate status refers to the original Chinese-name wrapper and should not be read as contradicting successful byte-identical-alias execution.
